title_zh: 憂鬱高風險兒童會「卡」在悲傷臉孔：眼動追蹤研究顯示兩種注意力路徑
title_en: Attention bias to sad faces in at-risk children
summary_zh: Binghamton 大學的縱貫研究（Journal of Psychopathology and Clinical Science, 2026）以眼動追蹤，每六個月評估一次、追蹤 242 名兒童兩年。母親有重鬱症史的兒童，在自身憂鬱症狀上升時對悲傷臉孔的注意增加；母親無憂鬱史的兒童則是症狀上升時對快樂臉孔的注意減少，顯示憂鬱可能依家族風險經由不同的注意力路徑發展。
summary_en: A Binghamton University longitudinal study (Journal of Psychopathology and Clinical Science, 2026) used eye tracking every six months over two years in 242 children. Children of mothers with a history of major depression attended more to sad faces as their depressive symptoms rose, whereas children without maternal depression showed reduced attention to happy faces, suggesting distinct attentional pathways by familial risk.
evidence_note: 縱貫觀察研究（兩年、每六個月評估），非介入研究，屬機制與風險標記證據。
caution: 眼動注意力偏誤目前是研究層次的風險標記，尚不能當作臨床篩檢工具使用。
brief_zh: 242 名兒童與母親，依母親重鬱症史分組
眼動追蹤：中性臉 vs 快樂、悲傷、憤怒臉
高風險組：症狀上升 → 更注視悲傷臉
低風險組：症狀上升 → 較少注視快樂臉
brief_en: 242 children and mothers, grouped by maternal MDD history
Eye tracking: neutral vs happy, sad, angry faces
High-risk: rising symptoms → more attention to sad faces
Low-risk: rising symptoms → less attention to happy faces
supervision_questions: 面對母親有憂鬱史的兒童個案，注意力偏誤的研究可以如何融入評估與親職工作？
高、低風險兒童的路徑不同（偏向悲傷 vs 失去對正向的注意），介入重點應如何區分？
在向家長說明遺傳與環境風險時，如何避免造成標籤或自責？

posts.title: Children at risk for depression get "stuck" on sad faces
posts.content: Binghamton 大學研究以眼動追蹤追蹤 242 名兒童兩年，發現母親有憂鬱史的兒童在憂鬱症狀上升時更注視悲傷臉孔，母親無憂鬱史者則是對快樂臉孔的注意減少。

related.title_zh: 自閉症學生為何在校較不快樂？英國 8,348 名青少年資料：學業自信與霸凌是關鍵
related.summary_zh: National Elf Service 評介一項英國全國代表性樣本研究（8,348 名青少年，其中 271 名自閉症）：自閉症學生約 27% 表示大多或全部時間在校不快樂，非自閉症學生約 14%。但在納入學業自我概念、霸凌、同儕關係、家庭親密度與社經地位後，差距消失；在自閉症學生中，學業自信是在校快樂感最強的預測因子。
related.summary_en: A Mental Elf blog reviews a UK nationally representative study (8,348 adolescents, 271 autistic): about 27% of autistic pupils felt unhappy at school most or all of the time versus 14% of peers, but the gap disappeared after accounting for academic self-concept, bullying, peer relationships, family closeness and SES. Academic confidence was the strongest predictor of school happiness among autistic pupils.

related.title_zh: 12 歲孤單、18 歲孤立：2,232 名雙胞胎追蹤顯示兒童期孤單與孤立的長期代價
related.title_en: Childhood loneliness and isolation into adulthood
related.summary_zh: PsyPost 報導一項刊於 Development and Psychopathology 的縱貫研究，追蹤 2,232 名英格蘭與威爾斯雙胞胎從 12 歲到 18 歲。12 歲感到孤單的兒童，到 18 歲成為社交孤立者的機率約為兩倍；兒童期社交孤立與 18 歲時未就學未就業（NEET）勝算 2.4 倍相關。孤單與孤立各自獨立預測較差的心理健康、幸福感與社經結果。
related.summary_en: PsyPost reports a Development and Psychopathology study following 2,232 twins in England and Wales from age 12 to 18. Children who felt lonely at 12 were about twice as likely to be socially isolated at 18, and childhood isolation was linked to 2.4 times higher odds of being NEET. Loneliness and isolation independently predicted poorer mental health, wellbeing and socioeconomic outcomes.

related.title_zh: 兒福聯盟調查：三成五國高中生有容貌焦慮，口罩成「第二張臉」
related.title_en: Taiwan survey: 35% of teens report appearance anxiety
related.summary_zh: 兒福聯盟問卷調查全臺一萬多名國高中生，35.4% 自陳有容貌焦慮，少女 48.7%、少男 20.6%；23.5% 每天超過一半時間戴口罩，37.2% 看到他人網路照片後曾覺得自己很醜，47.8% 曾被平台主動推播相關內容。高容貌焦慮組有 25.1% 嚴重情緒困擾、29.6% 有自殺意念；兒盟建議理解口罩背後的心理防衛、避免強摘口罩或批評外貌，並以「鏡子練習」建立自我接納。
related.summary_en: A Children's Welfare League survey of over 10,000 Taiwanese secondary students found 35.4% report appearance anxiety (girls 48.7%, boys 20.6%). Among high-anxiety students, 29.6% reported suicidal ideation; 47.8% said platforms pushed appearance-related content to them.
